stop_reason: BUILD-09R-2 delivered seven purpose-built high-value workspace groups (waves; cycle counting; traceability+recall; shop-floor terminal+work-centre queue; quality hold/rework/scrap; downtime+operational performance; and the dock group - schedule/check-in/staging/cross-dock) on a new shared kernel (modules/build09r-shared.js), taking BUILD-09 from 2 to 20 of 32 purpose-built pages across 7 tested-and-pushed commits. IMPORTANT: the dispatching prompt's premise was stale - it named d74c3bfc as HEAD and described BUILD-10's frontend as an unbuilt 138-line stub with 6 red tests, but the remote was already 6 commits ahead and those commits had built it. This was verified rather than assumed: test:build-10 is 37/37 including all 3 Chromium lifecycle tests, so BUILD-10 was left alone and the session went to the prompt's own next priority (Phase G). Verification: test:build-08 17/17, test:build-09 55/55 (35 baseline preserved + 20 new), test:build-10 37/37, test:permissions 39/39, test:migration 5/5, test:autopilot 3/3. Migrations 081-085 untouched; no payroll/attendance/timesheet path touched. BUILD-09R remains IN_PROGRESS on purpose: 12 pages are still on the generic shell and are pinned by name in tests/build-09/build09r2-bespoke-contract.test.mjs. Marking it COMPLETE because a numeric target was met, rather than because coverage is done, would be false closure. BUILD-11 remains PENDING and untouched.
